summary: Welltower OP LLC issued C$750M 3.850% Notes due 2031 and C$400M 4.150% Notes due 2033 via an automatic shelf registration. The notes are guaranteed by Welltower Inc. on a senior unsecured basis. The underwriters included RBC Dominion Securities, Scotia Capital, TD Securities, and BMO Nesbitt Burns. This debt issuance is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. There is no premium, shareholder vote, or regulatory clock. This is an ordinary debt offering by a REIT to raise capital. No risk-arb angle applies.
